name: Phat Diem stone church
kicker: Stone and wood at Kim Sơn
summary: A stone-and-wood church at Kim Sơn, built from 1875 to 1898. Đức cha Phê rô Trần Lục directed the work at xã Lưu Phương. Phương đình rises three stone storeys. Nhà thờ Lớn is wood, and the lim columns are counted as 16 and as 52. The complex became a national relic in 1987. Nguyễn Công Trứ’s reclamation of Kim Sơn dates to 1829. Ride out when a boat already has the morning.
dotReason: The Kim Sơn church, a separate ground from the karst
heroCaption: The stone front and the wooden nave at Phát Diệm
body: The complex went up from 1875 to 1898 under Đức cha Phê rô Trần Lục, at xã Lưu Phương, huyện Kim Sơn. Kim Sơn’s reclamation is dated to Nguyễn Công Trứ in 1829. Buildings in the group include the phương đình, nhà thờ Lớn, the chapels of Phê rô, Giu-se, and Rô Cô, and a grotto. Phương đình is three stone storeys. Điện Trái tim Đức mẹ, also called nhà thờ đá, is stone from the floor to the roof.

Nhà thờ Lớn is wood: six rows of lim columns, counted both as 52 columns and as 16 columns. It became a national relic in 1987. The hero is the stone chapel front, the cross, and the wooden nave beside it. The second frame is that stone front, closer. The support phone is 02293.862.058.

gettingThere: Xã Lưu Phương, huyện Kim Sơn. The church is a ride out from the karst valley and from Ga Ninh Bình. Châu Sơn, in Nho Quan, is about 65 km from this church.
